title: Constraint-violation formatter updated in only one of three duplicate copies, leaving divergent twins
evidence:
server/src/application/document_upload.gleam:674:      "Constraint violated: " <> constraint <> ": " <> message
server/src/application/application_handler.gleam:2447:      "Constraint violated: " <> constraint <> " — " <> message
server/src/ai/scoring_gate.gleam:98:      "Constraint violated: " <> constraint <> " — " <> message
detail: Same private helper duplicated in three files; PR re-composed only document_upload's copy, so operator logs now show two separator formats for one error class. Outputs are developer-facing only.
recommended_fix: Extract one shared helper (e.g. a server common module) and use it at all three call sites, or update the two twins to match.
